answer_mode: unconstrained top-1 next token choosing among four visible option labels

competence_gate.example_rule: full-context correct AND gold-only correct AND no-context incorrect

amendment.timing: after competence-only smoke tests and before any v2 intervention outcome
amendment.reason: The v1 smoke set was answerable without context, so aggregate accuracy could not identify evidence routing. The frozen v2 rule conditions only on pre-intervention competence and context dependence. The train split replaces validation solely because validation contains too few one-token-source candidates for the preregistered pool. For efficiency, no-context is evaluated first and full/gold contexts are evaluated only for no-context failures; this is set-theoretically identical to applying the three-part rule to the whole pool.

notes: This is a distinct competence-first follow-up to the failed open-answer SQuAD protocol. The eligibility rule is frozen before causal intervention evaluation; no source-max or matched-control outcome is used to select examples.
